editorial.blurb: Kinjo is a transcendent fusion experience where Japanese and Italian traditions meet under the passionate direction of Chef Jada, delivered with intimate warmth that feels like dining with friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Request the chef's counter seating when you book—reviewers unanimously praise this intimate vantage point for watching the chefs work and feeling truly part of the experience, especially for special occasions.
